rootSupplementalResearch.observation: City Natural Resources and Planning Bureau article explicitly describes the city’s online real-property registration information and cadastral-map visualization service. It uses Jiangsu unified government identity authentication and real-name verification before entry. Query modes include unit/parcel code, fuzzy location and map clicking; results can expose property, registration, mortgage and other status fields. No login or data query was attempted.
City bureau responsibilities include unifying natural-resource and real-property registration, cadastral surveys, registration information platform and record management.
Linked municipal Tianditu map portal; no public parcel schema was verified in this review.
